description: Code-generation framework for Go test suites: suite structs with lifecycle hooks, fixtures, BDD structure, type-safe assertions, fuzzing, benchmarks and snapshots.
rules: Run the CLI as `go tool gotest`, declared with `go get -tool github.com/mvrahden/go-test/cmd/gotest@<version go.mod requires>`; never a global `go install` binary.
`go test` does not run suites and `go tool gotest` does not run stdlib tests; a complete run is both.
Use BeforeAll/AfterAll and BeforeEach/AfterEach for resources; never t.T().Cleanup() or defer inside suite methods.
Gate environment-dependent suites with `SuiteGuard() string`, not t.T().Skip().
Inside Eventually/Consistently callbacks use only gotest assertions; `poll` is a *gotest.R and has no T().
Use Zero/NotZero for comparable nilables, Empty/NotEmpty for slices and maps, Regexp for prefix and suffix checks.
With `Parallel: true` and per-test state, BeforeEach must return a context struct pointer; never write suite fields from parallel methods.
